reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000851 (the melody read from 000851a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells James Proctor Harding as “James [John?] P. Harding”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. James Proctor Harding's dates (1850–1911) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Harding_James (Harding, James Proctor, 1850-1911; MORNING STAR; first name sometimes given as John, birth year also printed 1859 or 1861); https://www.commonprayeronline.org/en/hymn/H82/117/text (Hymnal 1982: James Proctor Harding, 1850-1911) agrees; CCEH's page gives only the year 1861. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000851a.nwc).
